notes: Unless a model lists its own rate: cache writes cost 1.25x the input price with the 5-minute TTL and 2x with the 1-hour TTL, cache reads 0.1x.
`match` is a model id; dated snapshots such as claude-haiku-4-5-20251001 match their base id.
`fast` multiplies every rate for responses served in fast mode.
A model missing here is reported as unpriced instead of guessed. Add it with the rates from the source page.
